class.name: StretchViewportContainer
class.brief_description: A [SubViewportContainer] that shows its [SubViewport] the way the enclosing [Window] shows the root.
class.description: Its [SubViewport] follows the window's content scale and copies its render settings. It renders, plays audio and takes input only while the container is [member CanvasItem.visible]. [codeblock] var view := StretchViewportContainer.new() view.add_child(session) [/codeblock]
